name: Media wall with lit shelves, TW14 (design)
source: Built in Trimble SketchUp through the connector (12 Oct 2026) for design request design-2026-10-media-wall-tw14-17zh, from the customer's drawing (cm): 4470 wide, 2400 to the ceiling; base cupboards 570 high on a 100 plinth with ten shaker doors (450, 450, six of 445, 450, 450) and brass knobs where each pair meets; two niches 800 wide (760 inside) from the base top to 2100 with shelves at about 1010, 1330 and 1650; a 2270 wide moulded frame round a 75 inch TV (1680 x 1020, bottom at 920); a plain band to 2300 and a cornice to the ceiling. Standard, not on the drawing: 320 deep boarded wall, cupboards 452 deep with doors, fluted backs in the niches, LED strips at the back of each shelf. Units mm, X along the back wall, Y out from it (the room is -Y), Z up.
